description: REST API endpoints bridging the MYBOTSHOP Webserver UI with the underlying ROS2 Imitation Learning backend.

endpoints.description: Spins up the ROS2 Data Collector node in a background process to begin synchronizing and recording teleop data.
Sends a SIGINT to the Data Collector node, safely flushing HDF5 buffers and closing the dataset.
Triggers the PyTorch Behavior Cloning script as an async job. Returns a task_id to poll for progress.
Allows the Web UI to poll the current training progress to display a loading bar or loss graph.
Halts teleoperation streams and spins up the Inference Node, handing hardware control over to the PyTorch model.

response.message: Autonomy node started. Robot is currently under AI control.

endpoints.description: Emergency Stop. Immediately kills the Inference Node and halts all ROS2 hardware controllers to ensure safety.
